course.title: TV Engineering
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: A planar LED is fabricated from gallium arsenide which has a refractive index of 3.6. (i) Calculate the optical power emitted into air as a percentage of the internal optical power for the device when the transmission factor at the crystal air interface is 0.68. (ii) When the optical power generated internally is 50% of the electric power supplied, determine the external power efficiency.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
